purpose: editor.md is the prose document that the Programmer copies verbatim into HTML. Every section header includes the edt_xx ID; every section lists its evidence (ana_xx) and context (det_xx) on the line below the header. This creates a clear audit trail from prose to data.
paragraph_source_tags:
Prefix every paragraph with the IDs it draws on, so the Programmer knows exactly which

references which finding. If a paragraph uses no specific finding (pure editorial connective tissue), tag it [editorial].
template: [ana_01] First paragraph — draws on this specific finding, with actual numbers.
[ana_04, det_02] Second paragraph — mixes a data finding with detective context.
[editorial] Third paragraph — pure narrative connective tissue, no specific data claim.
[ana_07] First paragraph with numbers from this finding.
- [Which numbers must be exact, which caveats must stay visible, which sections are load-bearing]
